records.name: Roasted Bengal Gram
records.description: Dry-roasted chickpea product commonly eaten as a snack.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Flavoured/salted products can contain more sodium.
records.servingSuggestions: Choose unsalted or lightly salted portions.
records.selectionTips: Choose dry, crisp product without stale or rancid smell.

records.name: Roasted Makhana
records.description: Popped seeds of Euryale ferox commonly roasted as a snack.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Flavoured versions can contain added salt and fat.

records.selectionTips: Choose crisp, dry pieces without moisture or stale odor.

records.name: Potato Chips
records.description: Sliced potatoes fried or baked and commonly seasoned.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Often high in sodium and fat; frequent large portions are not ideal.
records.servingSuggestions: Keep portions small and choose less-salted versions when available.
records.selectionTips: Check sodium, saturated fat and serving size on labels.
records.storageTips: Follow package storage instructions and keep sealed.

records.name: Namkeen / Mixture
records.description: Indian savoury snack mix that may contain fried legumes, flour, nuts and spices.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: May provide some protein depending on ingredients.
cautions: Often high in sodium and fat; recipe and brand vary widely.
records.servingSuggestions: Use small portions and pair with less-processed foods.
records.storageTips: Keep sealed and dry; use before best-before date.
